title: Mars Pathfinder IMP EDR filename
reference: Imager for Mars Pathfinder EDR Data Product SIS (v1.5), §2.2.2

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: An "I" marks an EDR from the Imager for Mars Pathfinder (IMP), the lander's mast-mounted stereo camera.

segments.label: Spacecraft clock
segments.description: Spacecraft clock start count of the exposure. Left, right, dark and null frames of one observation share it.

patterns.meaning: Least significant six digits of the spacecraft clock start count ({number}); the four leading digits are carried by the directory path instead

segments.label: Frame
segments.description: Which of the four frames the camera produced this image from.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: What the file holds. IMP returned calibration frames alongside the science image, each with its own extension.

title: Mars Pathfinder Rover camera EDR filename
reference: Mars Pathfinder Rover Camera EDR Data Product SIS (v1.5), §2.2.2

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: An "R" marks an EDR from a Sojourner rover camera.

segments.label: Spacecraft clock
segments.description: Spacecraft clock start count of the exposure.

patterns.meaning: Least significant six digits of the spacecraft clock start count ({number}); the four leading digits are carried by the directory path instead

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: What the file holds; the rear camera's colour frames are archived unpacked as .RGB.

values.IMG: Monochrome or packed-colour rear camera image
